steps.label: unpack
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && [ "$(md5 -q sd/sd_bundle.tgz)" = bd4e568e8183fd147a69bf70c06f8ba9 ] && [ "$(md5 -q sd/sd_mix.m4a)" = 162d2a52670464c71240eef5189ac46c ] && rm -rf sd/bundle && mkdir -p sd/bundle && tar xzf sd/sd_bundle.tgz -C sd/bundle && for f in sd/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done && ls sd/bundle/public | wc -l && npx remotion ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 sd/sd_mix.m4a

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render sd/bundle P sd_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i sd_out.mp4 -i sd/sd_mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest sd_film.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i sd_film.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 27 -c:a aac -b:a 128k sd_720.mp4 && ls -l sd_film.mp4 sd_720.mp4 > sd_done.txt; cat sd_done.txt
